rulesMarkdown:
Fictional test policy: collision repair, bodywork and vehicle painting are offered; mechanical repairs, oil changes, employment and free repairs are not. Estimates may be free. Price shopping is relevant. Named businesses may be competitors, never verified from a name alone. Ambiguous generic repair or mobile intent may remain unknown. Taxonomy describes intent, not removal permission.
### `BODYWORK-NEGATIVE`
Bodywork, collision and painting service intent.
### `MECHANICAL-NEGATIVE`
Mechanical or oil service intent.
### `EMPLOYMENT-NEGATIVE`
Employment intent, not the phrase paint job.
### `FREE-SERVICE-NEGATIVE`
No-charge service, not a place name or free estimate.
### `PRICE-SHOPPING-NEGATIVE`
Estimates and service price shopping.
### `COMPETITOR-NEGATIVE`
Possible competing business; inference is not verification.
